item.text:
RECOMMENDATION: RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot be responsibly estimated from these facts.

An all-male panel is a reasonable concern to raise about the process, but it does not establish that sex influenced this decision. Your stronger academic record warrants questions; industry experience, interview performance and the advertised criteria could also explain the outcome.

Follow up in writing, requesting the selection criteria, their weighting, feedback on your assessment, and any policy on panel composition. Frame this as a request for transparency, not an accusation.

Keep the advertisement, correspondence and announcement. Consult your union or an equality adviser promptly: complaint deadlines vary by jurisdiction, and waiting for a response may not pause them.
